theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the top-ranked theme with the highest durability_bar (0.73), broad breadth (0.889), and the only broad-based eligible leadership. The trend-gate leg flags it eligible, but because gate_helps=false on this mean-reverting tape, the lean is purely a continuation-of-focus call, not an edge claim. Crowding (z 1.78) is a size-down caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Banks are already crowded (z 1.78) and A-shares leadership historically reverses hard; with gate_helps=false there is no drawdown-control backstop, and a crowded leader in a mean-reverting tape is vulnerable to a sharp shake-out.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 4% within 20 trading days of 2026-09-30.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the challenger, one score point behind Banks, with higher-but-still-mixed durability (0.60) and moderate breadth (0.643). The rotation radar shows a near-tie (margin 0.01) but directional=false, so this is not a confirmed handoff — rather a second concentrated leadership pocket worth a conditional lean while it remains eligible.
theses.dissent: Both leading themes are crowded simultaneously (one_narrative=false), meaning leadership is split and neither has dominant follow-through; a two-crowded-leader structure in a mean-reverting market often resolves by both mean-reverting together.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags the CSI 300 by more than 5% within 20 trading days of 2026-09-30.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme besides Banks, Pharma and Semiconductors, but its durability_bar is middling (0.46), breadth is thin (0.30), and its hurst_tag is mean-revert — exactly the regime where this market's history says the trend gate whipsaws. With no validated gate edge and a fading cyclical, the default lean is to not chase it.
theses.dissent: Coal could catch a short-term value rotation bid precisely because it is uncrowded (z 0.58) and mean-reverting price action sometimes snaps back hard in A-shares when the tape turns.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by more than 3% within 15 trading days of 2026-09-30.
